messages.content: Hey! Kaise ho? Aaj kya build ya code karna hai?
write poem on AI  in 100 words

Silicon minds and digital dreams,
Thinking faster than it seems.
Lines of code in neural space,
Evolving quick in human race.

Data deep aur algorithms fast,
Creating future, learning past.
Smarter logic, creative art,
Every sector ka bane ye part.

Naye zamane ka naya chiraag,
Har mushkil ka deta jawab.
Silent partner in work and play,
Guiding humanity day by day.

Duniya badal rahi hai aaj,
AI pe tika hai naya raj.
A bridge between the soul and mind,
The smartest companion of human kind.
